messages:
maria (eng-security): heads-up: DSAR deletion jobs started failing after last night's keystore rotation. deletion-worker 503s when calling kms.decrypt. @tim can you check key policy? logs show `PERMISSION_DENIED` from key ring.
raj (eng-sre): seeing same. stacktrace: `Error: permission denied: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/retention/cryptoKeys/dsr-key: cryptoKeyVersions/2`
tim (eng-platform): I rotated key per runbook at 02:10 UTC. I thought service account `dsar-deleter@redwood-prod` had access via binding, but I may have removed the old principal. Investigating now.
lena (privacy): if deletions are paused we need legal notice? Are any pending requests overdue? I'll pull queue.
maria (eng-security): looks like 42 deletions in the last 6 hours are in "pending-erase". Not yet overdue but close. We need temporary workaround + longer fix.
raj (eng-sre): quick mitigation: can we add a short-lived IAM binding to the previous key for the service account or run deleter with a different key? Prefer minimal blast radius.
tim (eng-platform): I can add a temporary binding: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding dsr-key --member=serviceAccount:dsar-deleter@redwood-prod --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` — will do, eta 5m. Will post audit entry.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: infra/keystore-rotate v2026.03.21 -> deployed by tim
raj (eng-sre): after binding added, job retried a few items succeed. still some failures with `ENCRYPTED_PAYLOAD_INVALID` — maybe cache mismatch.
maria (eng-security): action items: (1) tim to add temp binding + confirm audit logs; (2) raj to replay failed deletions after 10m backoff; (3) lena to notify privacy & legal if any become overdue; (4) I will file postmortem and propose RBAC policy guard in rotation runbook.
tim (eng-platform): temp binding applied and validated. audit log event: `principal:tim@redwood` change: added binding. saved in `projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity`
raj (eng-sre): retried 42 pending, 40 succeeded, 2 still failing. logs show those objects were already tombstoned in storage — delete job returns 404 -> mark as done. I'll sweep.
lena (privacy): confirmed no DSARs breached SLA window yet. will update tracker. Legal ok with temporary fix but wants root cause + prevent reoccurrence.
maria (eng-security): root cause hypothesis: rotation process didn't include verification step to assert service account bindings for all dependent keys. proposal: add an automated smoke test post-rotation that runs `scripts/dsar-smoke.sh` which attempts `kms.decrypt` + delete path dry-run.
tim (eng-platform): agreed. I'll add smoke-check into keystore-rotation pipeline and a gating step that fails rotation if smoke-check fails.
raj (eng-sre): also recommend an audit-alert: if deletion-worker gets >5 PERMISSION_DENIED errors in 10m, page eng-security + eng-platform.
maria (eng-security): I'll create an incident ticket and the postmortem. tagging folks: @tim @raj @lena. thanks.
lena (privacy): thanks all :thumbsup:
maria (eng-security): closing thread after postmortem created. rn incident ticket: INC-2026-03121
